outcome: neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) admission rates
cohort: The cohort consisted of 1128 pregnant women admitted to a tertiary care hospital between 2020 and 2025, classified into preterm and term delivery groups.
finding: Higher systemic inflammatory response index (SIRI) and neutrophil/lymphocyte ratio (NLR) were identified as independent predictors of preterm delivery and correlated with adverse neonatal outcomes.
gest_age: Gestational age was used to classify participants into preterm and term delivery groups, with further distinction between early, middle, and late preterm cases.
